Local Government Notifications
NOTIFICATION MADE UNDER SECTION 66C.(4) OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT INSTITUTES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE, CHAPTER 262, AS AMENDED BY THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT INSTITUTES ELECTIONS (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 22 OF 2012

By virtue of powers vested in me under Sub section 66C.(4) of the Local Government Institute Elections Ordinance, Chapter 262, As amended by Local Government Institutes Election (Amendment) Act, No.22 of 2012, I, Herath Mudiyanselage Sanjeewanee Herath the Commissioner of Local Government in the North Western Province, hereby notify that the meeting will be convened for the purpose of electing Chairman, Vice Chairman for the Local Government Institutions set out in the following schedule at the respective venue, time and date correspondingly specified in the following schedule itself.
H.M. Sanjeewanee Herath, Commissioner of Local Government, North Western Province.1st of July 2025.Department of Local Government, 2nd Floor, Vidusara, Provincial Council Office Complex,Kurunegala.
